parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is a wheel of the cart made of rubber, typically circular and attached to the base body for movement.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is another wheel of the cart, identical to the first one, made of rubber and attached to the opposite side of the base.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the other wheel to balance and move the cart efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle, synchronized with the other wheel for stable motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the cart, made of steel, forming the main structure that holds the load.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and serves as the container or platform for carrying items.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheels, supported by the axle assembly.
